In a video editor, use a **warm, clear English** text-to-speech voice with this exact script:

> Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.

Add it as the only audio track, with no music or captions. I haven’t modified your clip or generated a new file.

dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.
